offering_description.value: Operates private universities offering undergraduate and graduate degrees to students, including working adults and military learners. It delivers most programs online and combines online coursework, campus instruction and clinical placements for graduate health professions programs.

primary_services.value: Online undergraduate and graduate degree programs; graduate health professions education; professional continuing education

customer_segment.value: B2C: Working adults, military-affiliated students and aspiring healthcare professionals

end_markets.value: Higher education; adult workforce development; healthcare professional education

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and academic fees for degree programs and continuing education courses

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines faculty instruction, curricula and clinical placements to deliver degree programs to adult and graduate students

geography_served.value: US national: Online programs across the United States, with campuses in Colorado, Georgia, Florida, Texas and California

specialization.value: related lines: Online degrees in business, technology and other applied fields, plus graduate programs in rehabilitation and allied health

distribution_channels.value: online: University websites for enrollment and online learning platforms for instruction; own locations: University campuses for classroom instruction and hands-on training; partners / resellers: Employer education alliances that connect employees with university programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Universities require state authorization and accreditation, and federal student aid participation is overseen by the U.S. Department of Education.

notes: The current scope of standalone professional training offerings is uncertain.
